items.title: Egyptian banks launch android contactless payment services
items.summary: Egyptian banks have launched contactless payment services on Android phones, according to the headline only. Details of the scheme and customer rollout are not in the item.
items.idea: We could test whether Android HCE tap-to-pay can be added to the Birbank app for Bir Pay merchants, starting with a small pilot on Android devices.

dependencies: CBA approval for contactless and HCE credentials and any card scheme certification
NFC-capable terminal or merchant acceptance partner for Bir Pay
Tokenisation provider or card scheme token service integration
risks: Limited NFC terminal coverage among small merchants in Azerbaijan
Overlap with existing Apple Pay and Bir Pay QR, which may split adoption
Android device fragmentation complicating testing and support
sim.pilot: Run a two-week technical feasibility check with one Android model set and three Bir Pay merchants to confirm HCE tokenisation and terminal acceptance.
sim.mechanism: Birbank app adds Android tap-to-pay using host card emulation so Bir Pay merchants with NFC terminals or phones can accept a card or wallet tap from Birbank users, with the phone acting as the payment credential.
sim.segment: Android-using Birbank MAU who already pay at small merchants, with a pilot focused on Bir Pay merchant partners

items.title: Fonepay Launches Nepal Now App for International Tourists to Make QR Payments in Nepal
items.source: GN QR and tap to pay
items.summary: Fonepay has launched Nepal Now, an app that lets international tourists make QR payments in Nepal, according to the headline.
items.idea: We could let foreign visitors to Azerbaijan pay at Birbank-accepting merchants by QR using a temporary tourist mode in the app, starting with a pilot at Baku hotels and shops.

dependencies: CBA rules on onboarding non-residents and KYC for temporary users
Acquiring partners and Bir Pay merchant network in Baku hotels and shops
Foreign card or wallet acceptance route for visitors
risks: Non-resident onboarding may need remote identity checks that are hard to complete for short stays
Low tourist volume outside peak seasons
Visitors may prefer international card payments already accepted in Baku
sim.pilot: Sign up five Baku hotels and shops for Bir Pay QR and test a visitor-only onboarding flow with a limited number of foreign guests over one tourist season.
sim.mechanism: A temporary tourist mode in the Birbank app lets foreign visitors link a short-term account or card and pay at Birbank-accepting merchants by scanning a QR code, with spending limits and a time-limited profile.
sim.segment: Inbound foreign visitors to Baku, such as hotel guests and shoppers, who would otherwise pay by card or cash
